slides.title: No time to train? Take the *stairs. *Fast.
slides.body: Exercise snacks: short bursts that fit a full workday.

slides.title: *20 seconds *counts.
slides.body: Small 2019 study: 3 fast stair climbs of 20 s, 3 times a day, lifted fitness in 6 weeks.

slides.title: Tie it to a *trigger.
slides.body: After a call, before a coffee. The trigger does the remembering.

slides.title: Short and *fast.
slides.body: A little out of breath, then straight back to work.

slides.title: *Every bit *counts.
slides.body: WHO guidelines (2020): some activity is better than none.

slides.title: Count the *snacks, not the minutes.
slides.body: Three a day. Tick them off.

slides.title: Fitness lives in the *gaps.
slides.body: Follow @operatorhabits for one habit a day.
